out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the end of the cookline is blocked by a refrigerated prep unit.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC STATED EQUIP WILL BE MOVED. Doña Mesa (Inspection Date: 06/26/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: all equipment run through dishwasher while the sanitizer container was empty.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. SANITIZER CONTAINER WAS REPLACED AND EQUIPMENT RUN THROUGH AGAIN.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: refrigerated prep (near end wall): cut lettuce 58°F, black beans 68°F, chicken and beef flautas 51°F, 65°F, and empanadas 61°F. Atosa 2 drawer: steak. 48°F, ground beef 50°F, salmon 47°F. Atosa 2 drawer: chicken relleno 48°F, beef and cheese relleno 50°F, 48°F. And cheese chihuahua (2 bags) 47°F. Bev air ref prep unit salsa verde 56°F and grated cheese 65°F (in a double pan in the unit).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. ALL FOODS DISCARDED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quat solution was measured at 500ppm at the 3 comp sink.This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quat sanitizer solution at 200-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. DILUTE CHEMICAL. CALL FOR MACHINE SERVICE WAS MADE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: ref prep unit (end wall) and both 2 drawer fridges.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: exterior of refrigerated units.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
